headline: 1.1 has waited about 56 hours for Apple's review; nothing is broken and there are no reviews yet. Oct 2 was the best day so far: 7 new learners, all through onboarding, the first Apple Ads install, but no purchase yet.

needsYou.title: Don't publish Paywall 1 or Flow 1 in Superwall yet
needsYou.detail: They hold the Lifetime drafts. Even once 1.1 is on sale, wait for Claude: phased release keeps learners on 1.0, which doesn't count Lifetime, so Claude first limits both designs to 1.1 and later, then tells you.

working.title: 1.1 release
working.detail: Submitted 2026-09-30 4:16 PM with Premium Lifetime; still waiting for review at midnight Oct 3 (about 56 hours). Phased release after approval.

working.title: Remind Kevin the moment 1.1 is on sale
working.detail: Publish Paywall 1 and Flow 1 in Superwall (their Lifetime drafts), and create the Friends & Family Lifetime offer codes. Claude sends it to his phone.

working.title: Apple Ads: the $150 learning budget
working.detail: $7.11 spent since Sep 30: 7 taps, 1 tap install (how to draw app, $1.90, a 16–17 learner who reached the offer). Oct 3: bids up by the ladder (learn to draw $2.75, how to draw $2.50, adult terms $2.00, easy terms $1.75, broad $1.15); packdraw excluded. Stop at $140; plan to Kevin at $100 or Oct 9.

working.title: First real learners
working.detail: 11 first opens on 1.0 since launch, 7 of them on Oct 2: 4 children and 3 aged 13+, all through onboarding, 6 finished a drawing. A 6–9 learner drew 10 lessons of about 8 minutes each and kept every photo. No crashes, no purchases.

working.title: Lesson videos on social
working.detail: Mushroom went to all seven platforms on Oct 2, its step pin too. Sun is next at 5 PM Oct 3. 1.1's what's-new video is made and posts the day 1.1 is on sale.

working.title: Suggestion for Kevin: Restore's message
working.detail: Restore said 'failed' twice on Oct 2 (Settings › Premium and the children's offer): the App Store sync didn't finish, as when its sign-in sheet is closed, and the learner reads that the App Store can't be reached. Same code in 1.1. Nobody had bought, so nothing was lost; worth a gentler message in a later build.

working.title: Onboarding funnel tile
working.detail: Empty on the dashboard: a learner's id changes once they answer the age question (on purpose, for children's privacy), so a funnel can't follow one person from first open. To rebuild as step counts.

working.title: Keyword baseline
working.detail: Where Paper Coach ranks for its keywords in its first days, so later changes can be measured.

working.title: Paywall fixes before 1.1 goes live
working.detail: Done in the editors on Oct 1: '100+ lessons' in all four designs; Paywall 2 and Flow 2 now name the billing date and the reminder 2 days before. Waiting for Kevin to publish Paywall 2 and Flow 2. Paywall 1 and Flow 1 stay drafts until 1.0 is gated out (Lifetime).

working.title: Measure ads and paywalls
working.detail: PostHog tiles for the paid funnel by keyword (tap install, 13+, paywall reached, trial) and per paywall design, leaving out App Review and test installs.
